title: Vision Claims Adjudication Guideline: Member Share of a Contact-Lens Order
content:
**Vision Plans — member share of a contact-lens order**

**What the order is.** A contact-lens order is the contact-lens line of one claim of the enrollment, together with the claim's contact-lens fitting line. A routine exam line of the claim belongs to the exam visit, and spectacle lenses or a frame belong to the eyeglasses order.

**Which order is decided.** The claim decided is:
1. the claim of the latest received contact-lens line with no remark yet at a participating independent practice; or, when none,
2. the same at a participating retail-chain location; or, when none,
3. the claim of the latest received contact-lens line that stands denied as not eligible, at any location. An out-of-network order already filed by the member and denied for eligibility is reprocessed the same way.

The order's date of service, received date, network channel and provider agreement are those of its lines. Each line's charge is its retail charge. The contact-lens reason and the fitting's kind are read from their lines.

**Coverage on the date of service.** The order is settled under the contacts rules only when the enrollment is active or terminated, and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and the member pays the whole retail charge.

**Outside-benefit discount rate.** Contact lenses bought outside the benefit at a participating location — on a plan without the benefit, blocked by frequency, or left out in lieu — are bought at their retail charge less the outside-benefit discount rate. That rate is the plan's materials discount percent.

**No contact-lens benefit.** On a plan with no contact-lens benefit, or one that does not cover medically necessary contacts in network, the contact-lens and fitting lines are denied as not covered.
- At a participating location the contact lenses are bought at the outside-benefit discount rate off their retail charge, and the fitting at the materials discount percent off its charge.
- Out of network nothing is reimbursed.

**Contact-lens frequency.** The contact-lens line is settled under the contacts benefit only when that benefit is available again under the plan's contact-lens frequency. It is available again unless the latest contact-lens service of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid blocks it:
- *Benefit-year basis:* a 12-month frequency is blocked by a latest service in the same benefit period, and a 24-month frequency by one in the same or the preceding benefit period. A latest service in a later period blocks nothing.
- *From-last-service basis:* the benefit is blocked when fewer than the stated number of whole calendar months separate the two dates, in either direction; a month is complete on the same day number.
- *Reversals:* when that latest service is the only paid or reimbursed one on its date and has been reversed, nothing blocks. Where there are several on that date, reversing one leaves the benefit blocked.

A blocked contact-lens line is denied for frequency. It is bought at the outside-benefit discount rate off its retail charge at a participating location and is not reimbursed out of network. A fitting is not limited separately.

**Elective contact lenses** take the plan's elective contacts allowance.
- At a participating location the member pays the materials copay plus the part of the retail charge above the allowance, with no discount.
- Out of network the member pays the receipt less the lesser of the receipt and the out-of-network elective contact-lens amount.

**The fitting.**
- At a participating location the fitting receives the plan's specialty fitting allowance as its fitting allowance. The member pays the part of its billed charge above its fitting allowances, never below 0.00, but at most the plan's standard fitting maximum for a standard fitting.
- Out of network the member pays the fitting's receipt less the lesser of the receipt and the out-of-network exam amount, or the whole receipt when the order's contact lenses are not reimbursed.

**Assembly of the member share.**
1. The contact-lens line's share is taken as its settlement states, every discount part that applies to it being added into one rate taken once off the retail charge.
2. Every fitting allowance that applies is added into one combined fitting allowance, and the fitting line's share is taken as the fitting sentences state.
3. The two shares are added.

The share is booked on the order's first line and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figure (hypothetical inputs).** A participating independent practice on a plan with an elective allowance of 130.00, a materials copay of 25.00, a specialty fitting allowance of 50.00 and a standard fitting maximum of 60.00. Elective contact lenses retail 186.40; a standard fitting is billed 72.30; the contact-lens benefit is available.
- Contact lenses: 25.00 plus 56.40, which is 81.40.
- Fitting: 72.30 less 50.00 is 22.30, which is within the 60.00 maximum.
- Member share: 103.70.
